description: Prepare a React Native development server or ask connected apps to reload, using the development server this session is bound to. Explicit runtime inputs override that binding for one call. The binding is cleared when the session closes, and a fresh open without runtime hints also clears any leftover binding from a previous same-name session. Times out after 90s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

name: metro
